findings.highlight: It is not difficult at all.
findings.governingReading: Shirou tells himself that this should not be difficult.
findings.explanation: Not difficult at all converts desperate expectation into categorical ease.

findings.evidenceJa: なんの関心も持ち得ない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot spare the slightest concern for what is happening to his blood.
findings.explanation: No problem denies danger instead of showing his complete indifference to it.

findings.highlight: to really kill me this time
findings.governingReading: Berserker swings to cleave Shirou in two this time.
findings.explanation: Kill removes the concrete impending bisection.

findings.governingReading: Berserker brings the massive sword down on Shirou.
findings.explanation: The fragment drops the downward trajectory of the finishing strike.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺を巻き込むように身を返し
findings.governingReading: Saber turns her body as if sweeping Shirou into the motion with her.
findings.explanation: The English breaks off before the shared bodily motion that establishes their joint sword stroke.

findings.highlight: engulfs the giant’s body from the inside
findings.evidenceJa: 内側から閃光に包み込んだ
findings.governingReading: The embedded golden sword envelops the giant’s body in a flash of light from within.
findings.explanation: The English omits the flash itself, leaving an incomplete account of what engulfs him.

findings.evidenceJa: 刀身から砂となって消えようとしていた
findings.governingReading: The sword begins turning to sand and vanishing from its blade.
findings.explanation: From the tip loses both the sand transformation and the blade as the stated locus.

findings.governingReading: Berserker’s chest opens with a gritty, granular impression as the wound begins to crumble like gravel.
findings.explanation: Slowly replaces texture and sound with unsupported speed.
